name: Hypnagogia
summary:
Hypnagogia is a mini episode for Doom II set in the mysterious ruins of an ancient village. The main colours of the wad are purple, green, brown, tan and black. There's also flowers.

Originally started as a solo project but then turned into a friend group project. I let everyone interpret the theme however they wanted while also giving them the liberty to decide which kind of map they wanted to make.

UV should be manageable for most players that usually play wads on the hardest setting and like a little challenge. We spent a lot of time tuning and testing HMP and HNTR though, so please try those for a more relaxed experience. I personally think HMP is great for a casual blind playthrough.
